info.title: ai-catalog
info.description: CLI tool for working with AI Catalog documents (application/ai-catalog+json). Convert, explore, and install AI artifacts.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: AI Catalog CLI — convert, explore, and install AI artifacts

commands.name: convert
commands.description: Convert between AI artifact catalog formats

commands.name: marketplace
commands.description: Convert a marketplace.json to ai-catalog.json, packaging skills as zip files

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Convert an ai-catalog.json file into platform-specific plugin marketplace formats

options.name: --output
options.description: Output directory for generated plugin marketplace files

options.name: --source-dir
options.description: Base directory for resolving relative plugin source paths (defaults to the input file directory)

options.name: --github
options.description: Generate GitHub Copilot CLI marketplace output

options.name: --codex
options.description: Generate OpenAI Codex CLI marketplace output

options.name: --claude
options.description: Generate Claude Code plugin marketplace output

commands.name: explore
commands.description: Fetch and browse an AI Catalog from a URL

options.name: --show
options.description: Show details for an entry by identifier

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description: URL of an AI Catalog document

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install an artifact from an AI Catalog

options.name: --type
options.description: Artifact type hint: mcp or skill (auto-detected from mediaType if omitted)

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Base directory for installation (defaults to current directory)

arguments.name: ENTRY_ID
arguments.description: Identifier of the entry to install
